title: Entropy Regularization under No-Shorting: Structure Preservation and Convexity in Dynamic Mean-Variance Portfolio Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.13162v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies entropy regularization for the discrete-time dynamic mean--variance portfolio problem with no-shorting constraints. In the unconstrained setting, entropy regularization can be introduced without changing the basic quadratic structure of the dynamic program. Under no-shorting, this property is lost: a standard fixed-temperature formulation generally preserves convexity but no longer preserves the homogeneous Bellman structure and the associated piecewise-linear feedback form. We introduce a state-dependent temperature that is matched to the homogeneity of the original mean--variance problem. This restores the piecewise-quadratic value function and the finite-dimensional Bellman recursion. The resulting formulation, however, makes convexity depend on the continuation coefficients generated by the soft recursion. translated_title: 无卖空约束下的熵正则化：动态均值-方差组合选择中的结构保持与凸性
translated_abstract: 本文研究了带无卖空约束的离散时间动态均值-方差组合问题的熵正则化。在无约束情形下，熵正则化可以在不改变动态规划基本二次结构的前提下引入。而在无卖空约束下，这一性质不再成立：标准的固定温度公式通常能够保持凸性，但不再保持齐次Bellman结构以及相关的分段线性反馈形式。我们引入了一种与原均值-方差问题的齐次性相匹配的状态依赖温度。这恢复了分段二次价值函数和有限维Bellman递归。然而，由此得到的公式使得凸性依赖于软递归所产生的延续系数。我们证明了负的延续系数会导致凸性丧失，并证明了一种常见的充分……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文针对带无卖空约束的动态均值-方差组合选择问题，提出与原问题齐次性相匹配的状态依赖温度熵正则化方法，恢复了分段二次价值函数和有限维Bellman递归，并揭示了延续系数符号对凸性的决定性影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a state-dependent temperature entropy regularization matched to the homogeneity of the mean-variance problem under no-shorting constraints, restoring the piecewise-quadratic value function and finite-dimensional Bellman recursion, and reveals how the sign of continuation coefficients determines convexity.
